description: This circular walk explores the area around Feshiebridge in the Cairngorms National Park. On the way you will enjoy some fine views of the River Feshie and visit the Frank Bruce Sculpture Trail. The route passes through attractive sections of Caledonian pine forest with views towards the surrounding Cairngorm mountains. The sculptures are set within the woodland and were created by the local artist Frank Bruce, reflecting themes of Scottish identity and humanity. As you continue through the forest you may spot wildlife such as red squirrels and various woodland birds. The walk also includes open stretches with glimpses of the Spey Valley and the distant peaks of the Monadhliath Mountains before looping back to the car park near the bridge over the River Feshie.You can continue your walking in the area on theGlen Feshie Waterfall Walkor by visitingLoch Insh.Postcode:PH21 1NG
